title: Performium [expanded]
description: The only performance forked modpack you'll ever need.
body:
⚠️ **Important Notice**

I originally created Performium Expanded because I wanted to keep receiving future updates for Performium and continue using the experience it offered. When the original project was archived, I decided to continue building on its idea for my own use and to share it with others who enjoyed it as well.

Performium Expanded is my own continuation with additional improvements, updates, and changes while staying true to what made the original modpack great. It's my way of keeping the project alive and evolving for players who still want that optimized Minecraft experience.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29f0af1feffc348cd5a79de94be2fb8b573d1aaf_0.webp)

**Performium Expanded**

**About Performium Expanded**

Performium Expanded is a lightweight, optimized Fabric-based modpack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience with stunning visuals, seamless textures, and quality-of-life improvements—all while maintaining excellent performance.

**Features**

✅ Enhanced Visuals – Stunning shaders, connected textures, and refined models.

✅ Optimized Gameplay – Smooth mouse controls and performance tweaks.

✅ Minimalist Approach – Never over 50 mods for efficiency.

✅ Broad Compatibility – Supports Minecraft 1.20.4 – 26.1+ and works with:

🟢 Windows

🟢 Debian-based Linux Distros

🟢 Modrinth App

🟢 Prism Launcher

🟢 ATLauncher

**Always use the latest Performium Expanded version for the best experience.**

**Installation (Modrinth App)**

2. Download & Install the Modrinth App.

3. Login with your Minecraft account.

4. Browse on the left sidebar.

5. Search for Performium [expanded].

6. Download & Install the first result.



If you have questions or concerns, please email me at cursedemperorx@gmail.com
